name: Adobe Stock Keyword Gap Scanner
title: Adobe Stock Keyword Gap Scanner & Expander
uses: Stock photographers and videographers finding keywords with demand but few existing assets
Generative AI contributors checking how saturated a topic already is with AI images
Expanding seed keywords into Adobe related searches and Google autocomplete ideas
AI agents planning a stock content calendar from real result counts

inputs.name: mode
inputs.title: Mode
inputs.description: scan = result counts per keyword (gap scanner). expand = Adobe related searches + Google autocomplete from each seed. both = run scan then expand on the same keyword list.

inputs.name: keywords
inputs.title: Keywords or seeds
inputs.description: Keywords to scan and/or seeds to expand, e.g. walking pad, home office, autumn leaves.

inputs.name: usePublicReaderFallback
inputs.title: Use free public reader if Adobe blocks this IP
inputs.description: If stock.adobe.com returns a Datadome/captcha block (common on some datacenter IPs), retry the same public search URL through the free r.jina.ai reader. No paid proxy is used. Turn off to fail instead.

inputs.name: requestDelayMs
inputs.title: Delay between Adobe requests (ms)
inputs.description: Polite pause between Adobe Stock page fetches. For ~200 keywords, 400 ms keeps a weekly run short and cheap.

description: Scan Adobe Stock keyword saturation (total, photo, video, generative-AI share) and expand seeds into Adobe related searches plus Google autocomplete. No login. About $0.002 per keyword. 30/90-day new-upload counts are not publicly available.

sampleOutput.notes: Adobe Stock public search has no date-added or last-30/90-day filter. order=creation sorts newest first but does not yield a count of assets uploaded in a time window, and creation dates are not shown on public result pages.
